item.title: Babble, 2025-07-27, 09:16h
item.description: It’s hard not to be disappointed in myself for not taking oodles of screenshots and recordings of every conversation I’ve had on the Web with folk, because I definitely remember getting into contentious arguments with @Cyborgneticz@scholars.social about all sorts of stuff, generally focused around how directly to support antagonism of colonialism, and the risks around doing it for the marginalized. That is, they’d argue being queer is a risk, thus asking for greater antagonism is asking too much, and I’d argue that there are queers who aren’t white settlers that are antagonising things, and their stance, while fine to personally hold, presented as a truth, erases those people and those efforts.
